Infer local curb direction from visible rays instead of assuming the opposite contour normal.
Use an observed near-white anchor with bracketed paint/road area transitions; charge explicit raster, quantization and corner uncertainty towards the road.
Keep existing width-derived road evidence; add convex observed curb patches independently and exclude coherent grass, obstacles, opaque pixels and FOV gaps.
Retain the existing .35m horizontal-flank inset as its normal displacement; union removes internal patch seams.

Replacing existing road support with a new material estimate regressed saved clearances; corrected to preserve existing evidence and union separate new patches.
